basic_info.description: A Rare Gem in West Portal -Step into one of the largest single-family homes in the neighborhood, a truly exceptional, fully detached residence designed for grand living and effortless entertaining. This stunning, light-filled home showcases a refined open layout across three expansive levels, featuring 5 spacious bedrooms and 4 luxurious full bathrooms. The heart of the home is an exquisitely remodeled chef's kitchen, boasting premium finishes, high-end appliances, and elegant design perfect for culinary creations and gatherings alike. Set on an oversized lot, this residence offers ultimate privacy and comfort, with seamless indoor-outdoor flow. Enjoy the expansive deck, lush garden, stylish patio, and your own private hot tub, ideal for relaxing or hosting guests in style. The lower level features direct no-stairs access flex space perfect for multi-generational living or a private retreat. Moments from the vibrant charm of West Portal Village's shops, dining, parks, metro lines, and the library.
